description.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for P.quadrifaria. Official Maine Geological Survey specimen photograph and separate artist reconstruction support gross axial hierarchy, four ranks spiraling along axis, fertile clusters and sterile branching. Complete proportions, count, one-meter art height, basal anchorage and color are artistic, not measured fossil facts. Original architecture-level uncertainty retained; primary1972 publisher full text/plates unavailable403, not claimed inspected. Devonian refers to Trout Valley source context, not exhaustive range.
